subject: Hotspawn counts differ from the parseable open slate
detail: The page header says "131 matches this week"; the ng-state payload yields 387 fixtures, of which 261 have a lock time in the future. Weekly counts include fixtures from other titles and rows already locked; the fixtures table is the authoritative list and is complete for the payload.

subject: 114 Hotspawn rows are scheduled in the past but still listed as scheduled
detail: These rows carry a scheduled start months before this capture and no bookmaker still prices them; they are listed here for completeness but are not part of the pickable slate and get no line or pick.

subject: 255 open fixtures have no external market line
detail: No price could be read from the sources this run (a source that returns an error or serves no odds table is recorded as a refusal). Those rows show the price as blank, exactly as read — nothing is estimated.

subject: 234 open fixtures have no originated line
detail: At least one team in the fixture has no row with an exact name match in the HLTV ranking or Valve's standings, so no rating-based probability is invented for it.

subject: 255 open fixtures have no pick at all
detail: Neither a market line nor an official rating pair is available for these rows, so they are published blank with this flag rather than filled in.

subject: 1 fixtures where the market price and our own rating line disagree
detail: For these rows the external bookmaker price and the official-rating model point at different winners. The pick stays with the market price (it is the observable market view), the model's side is shown next to it, and both source links are on the row. A disagreement is information, not an error: it says the two independent methods are not telling the same story here.

subject: Hotspawn's printed wall-clock time is not a reliable UTC value
detail: The printed time next to a match is rendered for the viewer, and this project's own readings show the same fixture printed as both UTC and UTC-4 on the same pages in different sessions, while the ticker ("Locks in ...") and the ng-state epoch always agree. Every time in slate/data comes from the ng-state epoch, never from the printed text.

subject: No Hotspawn crowd percentage is used as a probability
detail: The crowd "% picked" values are readable from the payload. They are copied into fixtures.csv under column names ending in _audit_only for transparency, and no build step reads those columns. Every probability on the site comes from an external bookmaker price, from our own official-rating model, or is blank.

subject: Rating model is provisional, not an official probability
detail: Scale 400 and equal-weight rating blend are project assumptions, not calibrated forecasts or Valve/HLTV published win probabilities. Unknown series format means no series probability or model-only match pick. Map estimates remain in Own lines for research only.

subject: Secondary aggregator and historical prices cannot drive current picks
detail: Only fresh primary Pinnacle quotes, exact/evidence-linked names and kickoff within 15 minutes, drive market picks. EGamersWorld observations are secondary reports, not verified against the named bookmaker; see Market lines. Historical session readings are excluded, not refreshed by relabelling.
